<module id="float_multi">
    <description>32-bit floating-point multiplier for IEEE-754 standard single-precision arithmetic.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="rst">Reset signal (active high).</input>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First operand in IEEE 754 format.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second operand in IEEE 754 format.</input>
        <output id="z" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the multiplication in IEEE 754 format.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="INPUT_PROCESSING">Processing input operands.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SPECIAL_CASES">Handling special cases.</parameter>
        <parameter id="NORMALIZATION">Normalizing mantissas.</parameter>
        <parameter id="MULTIPLICATION">Performing multiplication.</parameter>
        <parameter id="ROUND_ADJUSTMENT">Rounding and adjusting the result.</parameter>
        <parameter id="OUTPUT_GENERATION">Generating the final result.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <signal id="counter" type="reg [2:0]" description="Cycle counter for operation sequencing."/>
        <signal id="a_mantissa" type="reg [23:0]" description="Mantissa of input number A."/>
        <signal id="b_mantissa" type="reg [23:0]" description="Mantissa of input number B."/>
        <signal id="z_mantissa" type="reg [23:0]" description="Mantissa of output number Z."/>
        <signal id="a_exponent" type="reg [9:0]" description="Exponent of input number A."/>
        <signal id="b_exponent" type="reg [9:0]" description="Exponent of input number B."/>
        <signal id="z_exponent" type="reg [9:0]" description="Exponent of output number Z."/>
        <signal id="a_sign" type="reg" description="Sign bit of input number A."/>
        <signal id="b_sign" type="reg" description="Sign bit of input number B."/>
        <signal id="z_sign" type="reg" description="Sign bit of output number Z."/>
        <signal id="product" type="reg [49:0]" description="Intermediate product of the mantissas."/>
        <signal id="guard_bit" type="reg" description="Guard bit for rounding."/>
        <signal id="round_bit" type="reg" description="Round bit for rounding."/>
        <signal id="sticky" type="reg" description="Sticky bit for rounding."/>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if (rst) begin
                counter <= 3'b000;
                a_mantissa <= 24'b0;
                b_mantissa <= 24'b0;
                z_mantissa <= 24'b0;
                a_exponent <= 10'b0;
                b_exponent <= 10'b0;
                z_exponent <= 10'b0;
                a_sign <= 1'b0;
                b_sign <= 1'b0;
                z_sign <= 1'b0;
                product <= 50'b0;
                guard_bit <= 1'b0;
                round_bit <= 1'b0;
                sticky <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                case (counter)
                    3'b000: begin
                        // Input processing
                        a_mantissa <= a[22:0];
                        b_mantissa <= b[22:0];
                        a_exponent <= a[30:23];
                        b_exponent <= b[30:23];
                        a_sign <= a[31];
                        b_sign <= b[31];
                        counter <= 3'b001;
                    end
                    3'b001: begin
                        // Special cases handling
                        if ((a[31:23] == 8'hFF && a[22:0] != 24'b0) || (b[31:23] == 8'hFF && b[22:0] != 24'b0)) begin
                            // Handle NaN or Infinity
                            z_mantissa <= 24'b0;
                            z_exponent <= 10'hFF;
                            z_sign <= a_sign ^ b_sign;
                        end else begin
                            counter <= 3'b010;
                        end
                    end
                    3'b010: begin
                        // Normalization
                        if (a_mantissa[22] == 1'b0) begin
                            while (a_mantissa[22] == 1'b0) begin
                                a_mantissa <= {a_mantissa[21:0], 1'b0};
                                a_exponent <= a_exponent - 1;
                            end
                        end
                        if (b_mantissa[22] == 1'b0) begin
                            while (b_mantissa[22] == 1'b0) begin
                                b_mantissa <= {b_mantissa[21:0], 1'b0};
                                b_exponent <= b_exponent - 1;
                            end
                        end
                        counter <= 3'b011;
                    end
                    3'b011: begin
                        // Multiplication
                        product <= $signed(a_mantissa) * $signed(b_mantissa);
                        z_exponent <= a_exponent + b_exponent - 127;
                        z_sign <= a_sign ^ b_sign;
                        counter <= 3'b100;
                    end
                    3'b100: begin
                        // Rounding and adjustment
                        guard_bit <= product[48];
                        round_bit <= product[47];
                        sticky <= |product[46:0];
                        if (round_bit && (guard_bit || sticky)) begin
                            if (product[48] == 1'b0) begin
                                product <= product + 1;
                            end else begin
                                product = product + 2;
                            end
                        end
                        z_mantissa <= product[47:24];
                        counter <= 3'b101;
                    end
                    3'b101: begin
                        // Output generation
                        z <= {z_sign, z_exponent, z_mantissa};
                        counter <= 3'b000;
                    end
                    default: begin
                        counter <= 3'b000;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
